title: Exodus details written by someone living in New Kingdom Egypt
summary: Luke Caverns tells of Exodus details written by someone living in New Kingdom Egypt, about 1500-1000 BC at Egypt (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: A researcher named Luke Caverns, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, talks about the Exodus, the Bible story of the Israelites leaving Egypt. He says the details in that story could only have been written by someone who was alive in Egypt at the time it describes, roughly the New Kingdom period of ancient Egypt, around 1500 to 1000 BC. If so, the story would come from someone who saw that world firsthand rather than being written much later.
